deadline.value: Fall 2027 application deadline for the Ph.D. in Geography is December 15, 2026.
deadline.quote: Clinical Psychology, Social Psychology, and Geography | Tuesday, December 15, 2026

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required for the Geography Ph.D. program.
gre_general.quote: Please note: GREs are no longer required.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty with aligning research interests prior to applying (the Associate Director serves as first-year advisor until formal advisor selection in May).
supervisor.quote: Applicants are also strongly encouraged to contact faculty with whom they have aligning research interests.

funding.value: All admitted Geography Ph.D. students receive tuition remission, graduate assistantships for eight semesters ($30,313 for 2025/2026), and fully funded health insurance.
funding.quote: We commit to granting all admitted Geography PhD students tuition remission and graduate assistantships for eight semesters, paid at a nationally competitive rate ($30,313 for the 2025/2026 academic year) with fully funded health insurance, in order to foster a tight-knit, supportive intellectual community.

entry_route.value: Applications are welcomed directly from bachelor's holders (with or without prior Geography training); students are not admitted for a standalone master's but may earn an M.A. en route.
entry_route.quote: We welcome applications for admittance to our Ph.D. program annually from individuals with or without prior training in Geography. Students are not accepted for master’s studies only, although many choose to earn that degree en route to the doctorate

notes: Ph.D. Program in Geography spanning Earth System Science, GIScience/Remote Sensing, Climate change, Cryosphere, Ecosystem ecology, Land surface hydrology, Human-Environment Geography, and Urban-Economic Geography. Writing samples (with at least one sole-authored paper) are required.
